technical_debt.substitution: Playwright e2e tests for the anchor-chip → expand-accordion flow (TC-SR-063h, TC-SR-063e, TC-SR-063f) are NOT executed in CI. The Ultron-AP project has no headless-browser stack — adding Playwright/chromedp for one feature would impose a heavy dev-dependency. Behaviour is verified at the rendered-HTML and JS-source layers: tests assert the data-anchor attributes are present, the data-section attributes are present in expected order, and the anchor-chip.js file declares the replaceState + scrollIntoView + accordion-expand logic. Same precedent as help-page tech debt for FR-050/051/053.
technical_debt.reason: No browser CI infrastructure in this project; the JS file is small and reviewable; rendered HTML and JS source are deterministic.

technical_debt.substitution: 1-click selection on the segmented severity control (TC-SR-058E2E) is NOT executed in CI. Pill renders within 100 ms of submit (TC-SR-065e) and pill DOM-removed after applied transition (TC-SR-065f) are NOT executed in CI — both require timing assertions in a live browser. The inline JS in settings.html shows: setFormState() builds the pill DOM only when state !== 'idle' and removes it via host.innerHTML='' after a 2.5s timeout for state='applied'. The server-side test TestSettings_FormStatePill_NotPresentAtIdle confirms the at-idle invariant.
technical_debt.reason: Browser timing assertions can only be done in a real browser; the JS is reviewable from settings.html.
